text: The status of a document is the release status of ALP-EPC-00000-GE-PRC-0002 section 10: IFR (first issue), IFA (issued for approval), ACCEPTED (review code 1 or 2 on the latest issue; supplier documents when accepted by Istanbul EPC), IFC (issued for construction / final) and AB (as built). The status reported is that of the latest issued revision on the cut-off.
